name: Gummersbach (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Gummersbach (a tool on blue and a chequy field on yellow beneath a mural crown).
history: Municipal flag of Gummersbach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Gummersbach arms — tool and chequy with mural crown
